payout_quote: When current members (referrers) refer new individuals who meet our qualification criteria, both the referring member and the new member (referred) will each receive a $25 reward.
steps: Be a current Community First Federal Credit Union member 18+
Friend opens membership, states at account opening that you referred them (referrals cannot be added retroactively)

Within 30 days of opening, friend: pays $10 membership fee, signs all documents, and has ONE of: active direct deposit, an approved funded loan, a credit card with 5+ transactions, or debit card with 5+ transactions
Your $25 reward is credited after the 30-day review (within the first week following review)
catches: Cap: 20 referrals per calendar year ($500 maximum earning)
Friend must say they were referred AT account opening — late claims not accepted
Friend must be brand-new to the credit union (a beneficiary is the only exception)
Both accounts must be in good standing when rewards are processed
Credit union may modify, suspend, or terminate the program at any time
Employees and volunteers excluded as referrers
biggest_catch: Only $25 per referral — and if your friend forgets to say you referred them at account opening, nobody gets a dime.
eligibility: Current Community First FCU members 18+; referred members must be new-to-CU and meet qualifications within 30 days
timing: Qualification within 30 days of account opening; reward credited within the first week after review
